caption:
A corrected month is boring. That's the part nobody expects.

The trade count drops first — not from caution, but because the ones that were never decisions stop existing. The chart doesn't change, the read barely changes: what changes is that the stop stays where you put it and the position closes where you said it would.

Then results start meaning something, because every trade has a reason recorded next to it. A bad month becomes readable instead of frightening. Five per month.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll open the qualification.
